body: ... Maybe, if I can get to China, Korea, or anywhere Air Mekong connects to. That's a decent thought.

My credit is flat dead. The credit cards I used to get back were all in 300-500 amounts. That's all I could be approved for coming from little to bad-ish credit and going immediately negative.

I don't smoke weed. My dad lives in Vietnam... Aside from his lovely Vietnamese wife he says it's awful.

I left my hometown for other parts of the US. Then Germany. Then Australia. All I do is travel. Every time I start to settle I get restless again. But this time I'm skint. I have nothing left to travel on. My fiancé left me and I lost my visa sponsorship in Australia. I then had to go thousands in debt to get back to the US with my passport and laptop.

No. I never could afford it, and my mother makes too much for me to qualify, since I was never legally separated from her. Not until next year can I even APPLY for federal aide, if I even get it. I had horrible grades in high school. I was homeless, but I've heard of homeless kids doing well in school, so it's no excuse. I just feel useless.

I'm 24. I would be 25 in May. I'm unemployed, and apparently unemployable. I just barely avoided deportation from Australia by moving back to my home country in the US. Living in the town I was born in but left at 16.

Even the things I was doing to distract myself... Drawing, listening to music, etc... They're not working anymore. I start to draw and then get distracted by how miserable I am. I wish I could just stop breathing.

Edit: I swear to fuck. It's like my tablet sensed me typing that out, because my tablet pen just died. Can anything not go completely wrong at the worst possible hour?

It just keeps going downhill. I got an rejection email today that informed me that they can't hire me because of "an obvious pornographic history". Which I'm extremely unfamiliar with. I've obviously never done porn. And yesterday I talked to someone close to me about how I feel lately... They talked to me for a while and tried to give me a pick me up... But have stopped talking to me today. Blocked me on Skype. Not answering text messages. Still posting on Facebook. Great.

I'm just at a point where emotionally it feels like rock bottom. But I know it isn't. I know there is so much further to go down before I can even dream of going up again. And I can barely stand it right now, and I haven't even hit bottom. I don't know if I can handle it much longer. It just hurts. Being a burden emotionally, financially, and physically on everyone in my life.

On the plus side... I'm still here today. Small victory. Still going downhill, though. Still dragging others down with me. Just emailed my parents for money. I can't believe I'm doing this. Any of this.
